title: Volume of Spheres and Composite Solids — Problems

problems.problem_text: Find the volume of a sphere with radius 6 cm (use pi = 3.142).
Find the volume of a hemisphere with radius 3 cm (use pi = 3.142).
Find the surface area of a sphere with radius 5 cm (use pi = 3.142).
Find the volume of a sphere with diameter 10 cm (use pi = 3.142).
A solid consists of a cylinder of radius 4 cm and height 10 cm with a hemisphere of the same radius on top. Find the total volume (use pi = 3.142).
A sphere has volume 288 pi cm^3. Find its radius.
A cone of radius 3 cm and height 5 cm sits on top of a cylinder of the same radius and height 8 cm. Find the total volume (use pi = 3.142).
Sphere A has radius 3 cm and Sphere B has radius 9 cm. How many times greater is the volume of Sphere B?
problems.solution: Scale factor k = 9/3 = 3. Volume ratio = k^3 = 27

problems.problem_text: A capsule consists of a cylinder of radius 2 cm and length 8 cm with a hemisphere at each end. Find the total volume (use pi = 3.142).
problems.solution: V_cyl = 3.142 x 4 x 8 = 100.544 cm^3. Two hemispheres = one sphere: V_sphere = (4/3) x 3.142 x 8 = 33.498 cm^3. Total = 134.042 cm^3

problems.problem_text: A sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into a cylinder of radius 3 cm. Find the height of the cylinder (use pi = 3.142).
problems.solution: V_sphere = (4/3) pi x 216 = 288 pi. V_cyl = pi x 9 x h = 9 pi h. 9 pi h = 288 pi. h = 32 cm

problems.problem_text: Find the total surface area of a hemisphere (including the circular base) with radius 7 cm (use pi = 22/7).
problems.solution: Curved surface = 2 pi r^2 = 2 x (22/7) x 49 = 308 cm^2. Base = pi r^2 = (22/7) x 49 = 154 cm^2. Total = 462 cm^2

problems.problem_text: A spherical water tank has radius 1.5 m. How many litres of water can it hold? (1 m^3 = 1000 L, pi = 3.142)
A cylinder and a cone have the same radius r and the same height h. A sphere has the same volume as the cylinder. Express the sphere's radius in terms of r and h.
problems.solution: V_cyl = pi r^2 h. V_sphere = (4/3) pi R^3. Equate: (4/3) pi R^3 = pi r^2 h. R^3 = (3/4) r^2 h. R = cube_root(3r^2 h / 4)

problems.problem_text: A solid consists of a hemisphere of radius r on top of a cylinder of radius r and height r. Find the total volume in terms of r.
problems.solution: V_cyl = pi r^2 x r = pi r^3. V_hemi = (2/3) pi r^3. Total = pi r^3 + (2/3) pi r^3 = (5/3) pi r^3

problems.problem_text: A sphere of radius 6 cm fits exactly inside a cylinder (touching the sides, top, and bottom). Find the volume of the space between them (use pi = 3.142).
Three spheres of radius 2 cm each are placed in a cylinder of radius 2 cm. The spheres just fit one on top of another (height 12 cm). Find the volume of the empty space (use pi = 3.142).
